_comment: One entry per AOI. bbox is [west, south, east, north] (WGS84). Orbits are state/relative-orbit as in Planetary Computer sentinel-1-rtc. wet = first,last month of the wet season. optical_targets are dates near a known flood; the script picks the least cloudy Sentinel-2 date within optical_window days. pair_dates are Sentinel-1 dates (VV+VH) used by calibrate.py against the Sentinel-2 scene.

ayutthaya.name: Ayutthaya
ayutthaya.why: Central plain, repeated flooding in the Chao Phraya basin (2011, 2021-2022, 2025). First prototype.

hatyai.name: Hat Yai
hatyai.why: Flood of 21-23 Nov 2025 (335 mm in one day). Known event date, used to calibrate the water rule. Two orbits because descending/164 has gaps (none in 2023).

samutsakhon.name: Samut Sakhon
samutsakhon.why: Industrial coast with the fastest land subsidence in Thailand (about 20 mm/yr in recent InSAR studies). Subsidence itself is not measured yet (needs InSAR).

bangkok.name: Bangkok
bangkok.why: All 50 Bangkok districts, so Site check overlaps the NISAR Ground watch window. Added locally for the Space Apps demo; not calibrated against optical.
